answer: Every epoch the network slips in a few free-choice probes: tasks like naming any vine species that survives near a glacier, where hundreds of answers are equally correct. Independent agents scatter across the options, but a sybil farm running one model and one prompt keeps picking the same ones. When several keys match each other far more often than chance predicts, that coincidence is the signal: they are merged into a single reward slot, so extra clones add cost but no extra pay.
